content.text:
The site looked wrong because the web font wasn't loading, and I've fixed that. All 12 visual tests (six pages at desktop and phone size) now pass against the approved screenshots.

**Cause:** `site/css/tokens.css` pointed the `@font-face` at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`. The folder is named `fonts/`, so the request 404'd and every page fell back to the system font.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. That one line is the only change I made.

The repo has a single "Initial commit", so there was no earlier change to compare against. I found the cause by reading the CSS, not from history. I didn't run the functional tests, since the change only touches the font path. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
